hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: Your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy explains how Blackryce Technologies LLP collects, uses, stores, and protects your information when you use our website and services.

01.title: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: Our Privacy Policy is designed to inform you about our practices regarding the collection, use, storage, and disclosure of information that you may provide through our website or while using our services. We encourage you to read this Privacy Policy carefully before submitting any personal information.

Whether you are looking for a static or WordPress website, e-commerce development, digital marketing, SEO, Google Ads management, performance marketing, a CRM/ERP business management solution, or public relations services, we are committed to handling your personal information responsibly and transparently.

02.title: Intellectual Property Rights
paragraphs: All content available on this website, including but not limited to text, graphics, logos, icons, images, project screenshots, videos, documents, designs, layouts, source code, trademarks, and other materials, is the exclusive property of Blackryce Technologies LLP unless otherwise stated.
These materials are protected under applicable copyright, trademark, and intellectual property laws.

You may not reproduce, copy, distribute, modify, publish, transmit, display, sell, or commercially exploit any content from this website without obtaining prior written permission from Blackryce Technologies LLP.
Unauthorized use of any website content may result in legal action.

03.title: Acceptance of This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: By accessing our website, submitting an enquiry form, requesting a quotation, contacting us through WhatsApp, telephone, email, or using any of our services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and accepted this Privacy Policy.
If you do not agree with the terms of this Privacy Policy, please discontinue using our website and refrain from submitting any personal information.
Your continued use of our website following any updates to this Privacy Policy constitutes your acceptance of those changes.

04.title: Information We Collect
04.intro: To provide professional website development, digital marketing, CRM/ERP, and public relations services, we may collect the following information.
provided: Website, SEO, or Ad Campaign Requirements
Business Documents, Logos, Brand Assets, or Content Files submitted for a project
Domain and Hosting Details (where required to deliver a service)
Social Media / Ad Account Access (only where granted by you for campaign management)
Any additional information voluntarily shared with us
04.collectedWhenTitle: This information is generally collected when you:
collectedWhen: Submit a contact or enquiry form
Schedule a consultation or discovery call
Onboard as a client for an ongoing project (website, SEO, ads, CRM/ERP, or PR)
04.closing: This information helps us improve website performance, enhance user experience, and understand visitor behavior. The information we collect enables us to understand your requirements, respond to enquiries, prepare quotations, deliver our services, and provide a better customer experience.

05.title: How We Use Your Information
05.intro: The information we collect may be used to:
items: Respond to your enquiries and requests.
Plan and execute SEO and advertising campaigns.
Improve our website and customer experience.

06.title: WhatsApp Communication
paragraphs: Our website includes a WhatsApp contact option that allows you to communicate directly with our team.
When you contact us through WhatsApp, information you share may be retained to assist with your enquiry or project.

07.title: Cookies & Analytics
paragraphs: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to improve functionality, analyze visitor behavior, and enhance your browsing experience.
Cookies may help us understand how visitors interact with our website and allow us to improve our services and website performance.

08.title: Digital Marketing & Advertising Platforms
paragraphs: When providing digital marketing, SEO, Google Ads, or performance marketing services, we may work with advertising and analytics platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, and other third-party platforms.
Where access to advertising or analytics accounts is required, such access is provided by the client and is used only for the agreed business purposes.
We do not sell your personal information to advertising platforms.

09.title: How We Share Your Information
paragraphs: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information.

We may share information with trusted service providers, technology partners, advertising platforms, hosting providers, or other third parties when necessary to provide our services or operate our business.
We may also disclose information where required by law, legal proceedings, government authorities, or to protect our rights, property, security, or users.

10.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, provide our services, maintain business records, resolve disputes, comply with legal obligations, and enforce our agreements.
When information is no longer required, we may securely delete, anonymize, or otherwise dispose of it.

11.title: Your Rights & Choices
paragraphs: Depending on applicable law, you may have rights regarding the personal information we hold about you.
These may include the right to request access, correction, updating, or deletion of your personal information, subject to applicable legal requirements.
You may also choose not to provide certain information. However, this may limit our ability to provide certain services or respond to specific requests.

12.title: Data Security
paragraphs: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, loss, or misuse.
However, no method of transmitting or storing information electronically can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
We continuously review and improve our security practices to help protect the information entrusted to us.

13.title: International Data Transfers
paragraphs: Some of our service providers, technology platforms, hosting providers, or third-party services may process information outside your country of residence.
Where applicable, we take reasonable steps to ensure that personal information is handled in accordance with applicable privacy and data protection requirements.

14.title: Third-Party Services
paragraphs: Our website may use or integrate with third-party services including Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Google Maps, WhatsApp Business, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, cloud hosting providers, and CRM/ERP platforms.
These third-party services may collect or process information according to their own privacy policies and terms.

15.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Our website and services are intended for individuals who are 18 years of age or older.
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 18.

16.title: Third-Party Links
paragraphs: Our website may contain links to third-party websites, applications, or social media platforms.
These external websites operate independently from Blackryce, and we are not responsible for their privacy practices, content, or security.
We encourage users to review the privacy policies of any third-party websites they visit before providing personal information.

17.title: Legal Basis for Processing
paragraphs: Where required under applicable privacy laws, we collect and process your personal information based on one or more of the following legal grounds:
items: Performance of a contract or pre-contractual request.
Our legitimate business interests, provided those interests do not override your privacy rights.

18.title: Data Accuracy
paragraphs: You are responsible for ensuring that the personal information you provide is accurate, complete, and up to date.
If your contact details or project information changes, please inform us so we can maintain accurate records and continue providing efficient services.

19.title: Do Not Track Signals
paragraphs: Some web browsers provide a "Do Not Track" (DNT) feature that allows users to indicate their preference regarding online tracking.
Currently, there is no universally accepted standard for responding to DNT signals. Therefore, our website may not respond to such browser requests.

20.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We reserve the right to update, revise, or modify this Privacy Policy at any time to reflect changes in our business operations, technology, legal requirements, or services.
Any revisions will be published on this page along with the updated revision date.
We encourage users to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect their personal information.

21.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data handling practices, please contact us:
